name: Welcome series
trigger: Joins the email or SMS list (pop-up, footer, competition)
goal: Turn a new subscriber into a first-time buyer
discount: Deliver the sign-up incentive in email 1. Never send a bigger code later in the flow.
benchmark: Often 3 to 6% of store revenue once list growth is steady

emails.subject: Welcome in. Here's your 10% off
emails.body: Thanks for joining. Your code is WELCOME10, ready to use today. We started [Brand] because [one-line founder reason]. Our best sellers are a good place to start: [3 products with one line each].

emails.subject: Why people switch to [Brand]
emails.body: Three reasons customers tell us they switched: [reason + short review], [reason + short review], [reason + short review]. Your code is still waiting.

emails.subject: Your questions, answered
emails.body: Answer the top 4 questions from support: fit or sizing, shipping times, returns, care. Link to the guarantee.

emails.subject: SMS reminder
emails.body: [Brand]: your 10% code WELCOME10 ends tomorrow night. Shop: [link] Reply STOP to opt out

emails.subject: Last day for your welcome code
emails.body: Short reminder with your best-selling product, top review and a clear button.

name: Abandoned checkout
trigger: Started checkout, no order within 1 hour
discount: No discount in email 1. Optional small incentive in the last message for new customers only.

emails.subject: Did something go wrong?
emails.body: Show the cart items, a reassuring line about shipping and returns, and one review. Button: Complete my order.

emails.subject: SMS
emails.body: [Brand]: your cart is saved. Free shipping over $[threshold]. Finish here: [link] Reply STOP to opt out

emails.subject: Still thinking it over?
emails.body: Address the top objection (price, fit, delivery). Add guarantee and 3 reviews.

emails.subject: A little something to help you decide
emails.body: New customers only: free shipping or a small gift. Returning customers get a reminder without incentive.

name: Abandoned cart
trigger: Added to cart, did not start checkout within 2 hours
goal: Bring back shoppers who showed interest
benchmark: Lower than checkout recovery but larger volume

emails.subject: You left something behind
emails.body: Product image, price, one benefit, one review, button back to cart.

emails.subject: Pairs well with...
emails.body: Show the cart item plus a complementary product or bundle that reaches the free shipping threshold.

name: Browse abandonment
trigger: Viewed a product twice or more in 24 hours, no add to cart (known subscriber)
benchmark: High volume, lower conversion; keep it helpful, not pushy

emails.subject: Still deciding on [Product]?
emails.body: One-paragraph guide to the product: who it suits, how it compares to the alternative, top review.

emails.subject: Our most loved picks
emails.preview: Based on what you looked at
emails.body: Three related best sellers with short reasons.

name: Post-purchase
goal: Reduce buyer's remorse and returns, set up the second order
discount: None in the thank-you. A loyalty or referral offer later.
benchmark: Improves repeat rate and reduces support tickets

emails.subject: Thank you, [Name]. Here's what happens next
emails.body: Thank you from the founder, shipping timeline, how to get the best out of the product.

emails.subject: How to get the most from [Product]
emails.body: Usage tips or a short video. Link to support.

emails.subject: Customers who bought this also love
emails.body: Cross-sell based on the first product. Loyalty or referral offer.

name: Review request
trigger: Order delivered + 7 to 14 days (based on how long the product takes to show results)
discount: Optional small reward for photo or video reviews (follow platform and local rules; never pay for positive reviews only).
benchmark: Review volume feeds product page conversion and ad hooks

emails.subject: Quick question about your [Product]
emails.body: Star rating inside the email, ask for a photo. Short and personal.

emails.subject: SMS
emails.body: [Brand]: how's your [Product]? A 30-second review helps a small business a lot: [link] Reply STOP to opt out

name: Replenishment
trigger: Days since order reaches the typical usage period for a consumable (for example 25 days for a 30-day supply)
goal: Win the reorder before they run out
discount: Subscribe-and-save option rather than a code.
benchmark: Strong for consumables: skincare, supplements, food, pet

emails.subject: Running low on [Product]?
emails.body: One-click reorder link, option to subscribe and save.

emails.subject: SMS
emails.body: [Brand]: time for a refill? Reorder in 1 tap: [link] Reply STOP to opt out

name: Win-back
trigger: No order for 1.5 to 2x your typical repeat interval (for example 120 days)
goal: Re-engage lapsed customers before they are gone
discount: Lead with what's new. Incentive only in the final email.
benchmark: Lifts repeat revenue; also cleans the list (suppress non-openers after)

emails.subject: It's been a while. Here's what's new
emails.body: New products, improvements, best sellers. No discount.

emails.subject: We saved you something
emails.body: Small incentive, clear expiry.

emails.subject: Should we stay in touch?
emails.preview: One click to keep hearing from us
emails.body: Ask to confirm interest; suppress if no engagement to protect deliverability.

name: VIP and loyalty
trigger: Third order, or lifetime spend above your top 10% threshold
goal: Recognise your best customers and keep them
discount: Early access, gifts and surprise perks over blanket discounts.
benchmark: Top customers often drive a large share of profit

emails.subject: You're one of our favourite people
emails.body: Personal thank-you, VIP perks: early access to launches and sales, a gift on the next order.

emails.subject: VIP early access starts now
emails.body: Early access link, limited quantity note if true.
